summary: Comprehensive testing of Zalites Pamatskola school site. Backend: 21/21 pytest tests passed (auth, news CRUD, schedule with conflict detection, pages, users). Frontend: All public pages, admin login, protected routes, admin CRUD pages, logout, dark mode, navbar all working. Minor deviations from spec noted (Vairāk dropdown missing Skolotājiem item, dashboard missing conflicts stat card, CORS misconfig).

minor.issue: allow_origins='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is rejected by browsers when sending cookies cross-origin. Cookie-based auth works only same-origin; frontend currently relies on localStorage Bearer token fallback. Recommend explicit origin list (e.g. https://campus-central-21.preview.emergentagent.com) when credentials are enabled.

ui_bugs.issue: Dropdown shows 'Skolēniem' and 'Stundu saraksts' but the third item 'Skolotājiem' is NOT visible/rendered. Spec required 3 items: Skolēniem / Skolotājiem / Stundas saraksts.
Dashboard stat cards show Jaunumi/Stundas/Lapas/Lietotāji but the spec required a 'Konflikti' (conflicts) stat card. /api/schedule/conflicts is not surfaced on the dashboard.

action_items: Add 'Skolotājiem' link to public Navbar Vairāk dropdown (currently only Skolēniem and Stundu saraksts render).
Add 'Konflikti' stat card on /admin dashboard wired to GET /api/schedule/conflicts count.

Fix CORS: replace allow_origins='*' with explicit origin list since allow_credentials=True (browsers block credentialed wildcard CORS). Currently working only because frontend uses Bearer token fallback.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS misconfig: allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' is invalid per CORS spec. Browser will block cookie-based auth.
seed_admin correctly updates password if changed (idempotent) ✓
bcrypt password hashing used ✓ (verified hashes start with $2b$)
JWT auth supports both httpOnly cookie and Bearer header ✓
MongoDB _id properly excluded in all responses ✓
Conflict detection covers both teacher and group overlaps on same day ✓
No brute-force lockout implemented (5-fail rate-limit not present); minor security gap but not in primary spec
seed_data_creation: No new seed data created. Backend auto-seeds 3 news items, 14 schedule entries, 4 page contents, 1 admin user on startup — all verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests at /app/backend/tests/test_zalites_api.py cover all endpoints with create→get→update→delete patterns (21 tests, all passing). Login returns both cookie and JSON token. Frontend public navigation, admin login flow, protected route redirect, dark mode, logout (button text 'Izrakstīties'), and admin sidebar navigation (Pārskats/Jaunumi/Stundu saraksts/Lapu saturs/Lietotāji) all verified working. Two spec gaps to fix: missing Skolotājiem in public Vairāk dropdown, missing Konflikti stat card on admin dashboard. Did not deeply test admin CRUD form submissions (create news with image, create schedule with conflict highlighting) — recommend retest after fixes.
rca of the issue: Vairāk dropdown: likely an array mapping in Navbar.jsx that only includes 2 of 3 expected nav items — check the dropdown items array. Dashboard conflicts card: Dashboard.jsx likely fetches /api/news, /api/schedule, /api/users counts but not /api/schedule/conflicts.length — add a 4th stat card.
